_doc: The Floodgate's set: Szadi art's RPG Worlds Wetland (RPGW_Wetland_v1.1) for the paved concrete yard, the stone face the pit walls come from, reeds and posts for the margins; Set 1 (RPGFW_Set1_v1.0) for the water blob and fill under the shallows. Keys: tools/cut_tiles.py. Paths are relative to the packs dir.

silt._doc: dressing (the Floodgate's Silt layer): Set 1's grass blob (g_terrain1, its ragged sides matched) laid in Wetland's brown dirt, toned as the shoulder (texture), so a fan runs out of it: silt where the channels spilled

moss._doc: dressing (Moss): Set 1's grass blob laid in Wetland's olive grass (the cobble swatch's grass, tiles 6-9 x 37-38), darkened toward damp moss: the paving overgrown along the stands and in the corners

path._doc: dressing (Paths): Set 1's grass blob laid in Wetland's mauve mud (tiles 1-2 x 22-23), greyed: trodden grime from the tunnels to the crossings

glint._doc: Wetland's glint loop (10 frames of 32 px; its pixels are already opaque, about 1 % of each tile, so no alpha_mul), lifted from teal to pale blue to sit on the tinted bed, cut in four phase-shifted, mirrored rows so the tiles do not blink in step

water._doc: the channels sit below the floor: a ragged shoulder of Wetland's brown dirt (greyed toward the paving) on the land round them (shoulder, at most about half a tile), then a thin kerb of the pack's mossy cobbles (MainLev tiles 36-38 x 23-25) at the water's edge, running along the top of the far bank's 15 px drop of the Wetland plateau's stone (edge_over_face); the near bank a lit lip; rounded corners; a dark wet line and a shade along the water, deepest under the face

overlay._doc: the pits' far wall: a seamless cliff face from the matching pack; the lip and the cracks: the floor's own fill (tools/cut_tiles.py cut_overlay)

pebbles._doc: Set 1 loose pebbles, found on their own

reeds._doc: Set 1 small water plants and low reed clumps

moss._doc: dressing (the Detail layer; kinds from here on are painted by atlas place, new ones go at the end): Wetland's one-tile olive-brown spot overlays turned green, moss in the paving's cracks and along the channel kerbs

silt._doc: dressing: Wetland's mauve-brown mud spots, splashes round the silt fans

grit._doc: dressing: Wetland's loose-cobble spots, broken paving

puddle._doc: dressing: Wetland's blue puddles (MainLev row 46-47 on the green grass) with the grass keyed out (clear: the same grass's flowered tiles), a little bluer: wet patches that catch the night's lamps

lily._doc: dressing: Set 1 lily pads in the shallows (as keeps.json)

leaves._doc: dressing: round chunks of Set 1's oak canopy turned a dull reed-litter brown, blown into the corners and along the kerbs

reeds._doc: the two tall clumps only: the sheet's lone stalk beside them ends higher and floated

reeds_small._doc: one clump, feet at its roots (the box's bottom is clear)

grate._doc: flat (the dressing's Flat layer): a drain grate let into the floor, composed: the middle of one leaf of Castle's iron portcullis (castle_outside) over a dark hole cut from Set 1's water bed, greyed a little

reeds_sway._doc: DecorativeProps vegB3, the dense tuft, green (colour row 1 = 32 px row 4); the first four frames of its 10-frame loop; feet on the middle stalk's roots

reed_sway._doc: DecorativeProps vegB1, one stalk, green; its roots end at y 23
